I’ve been playing 2K27 for a while now and I’m actually enjoying it, but I cannot recommend this game until 2K fixes the defending, MP is out here suffering.

I’ve got this man sprinting full speed, fighting through screens, throwing both arms in the air, jumping at shooters like his family is being held hostage, and somehow the game still says “semi-open”.

At this point my player is doing 5 minutes of cardio, getting smashed by screens, jumping like an Olympic athlete and watching 90% of contested shots drop anyway.

Sometimes I play perfect defence for the entire possession and the other guy just hits a fadeaway over me like I’m part of the crowd.

If someone gets open and greens it, fair enough. But if my defender has sacrificed his knees, lungs and mental health to HEAVILY CONTEST the shot, PLEASE reward him.

The game is fun, but defence in Park currently feels like unpaid labour.

This game is astonishingly bad from a technical standpoint. Pretty much every HUD element feels like it was simply copied over from NBA 2K23. I regularly get frame drops in places where they absolutely shouldn’t happen. They didn’t even bother adding new hairstyles.

I had only played the series on Xbox before, so I hoped that switching to much more powerful hardware would solve at least some of these problems. It didn’t. The game, the servers, and basically everything about it still feel just as broken as, say, the Xbox One version.

Mike Wang should be ashamed of himself for charging people money every single year and calling this crap a “new game,” when in reality they keep repackaging six-year-old gameplay and graphics and selling it as something new.

Not recommended.

I’m mostly a sandbox player, and MyNBA is easily my favorite mode because I love creating different storylines across all the eras.

That said, I really hope 2K can take another look at the NBA 2K27 simulation engine. Right now, the sim stats feel broken and unrealistic, especially when it comes to scoring, three-point shooting efficiency, and overall league-wide offensive output.

When you compare the results to both real-life NBA numbers and previous 2K games, there are noticeable inconsistencies that can really hurt the immersion of long-term MyNBA saves.

For players like me who spend most of their time simulating seasons, building alternate NBA histories, and creating different scenarios, realistic stats are a huge part of the experience.

Really hoping this gets addressed in an upcoming patch. MyNBA has so much potential, and fixing the simulation engine would make a huge difference!

I have been playing NBA 2K for 8 years, and this is honestly one of the worst experiences I’ve had with the series.

I was permanently banned because of a tattoo on my player. I did not insult, harass, threaten, or target anyone, and the tattoo did not contain anything racist, sexist, or hateful. Despite this, my account was permanently banned, and I was not given a clear explanation of exactly what rule I violated.

The moderation system is especially frustrating because players can apparently face serious consequences without clearly understanding what triggered the punishment. If you rage quit because of frustrating gameplay, and the opposing team reports you afterward, you may be putting your account at risk. I cannot confirm that a report alone causes a permanent ban, but based on my experience, players should be aware of how unpredictable the moderation system can feel.

The contest system and shooting mechanics also make the gameplay extremely frustrating. In my opinion, the gameplay mechanics are among the worst in the 2K series, and the combination of frustrating gameplay and unclear moderation makes the experience even worse.

After 8 years of playing 2K, this is incredibly disappointing. Players should be given clear explanations, warnings when appropriate, and a reasonable opportunity to understand and correct whatever rule they supposedly violated before receiving a permanent ban.
